note: Media Thumbnails SVG implements a single MediaThumbnail plugin (id media_thumbnail_svg) for MIME image/svg + image/svg+xml, rasterizing SVG media to PNG thumbnails via GraphicsMagick -> ImageMagick -> GD (meyfa/php-svg). It has NO config of its own (configure=null); output width/background are read from the PARENT media_thumbnails.settings config object (width, bgcolor_active, bgcolor_value) edited at /admin/config/media/thumbnails. Shipped defaults width=500, bgcolor_active=false, bgcolor_value=#eeeeee. Medium/hard cases are grounded in those keys of media_thumbnails.settings (the config this SVG plugin consumes); cleanup/reset restore the shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: How does media_thumbnails_svg plug into the Media Thumbnails framework? Give the plugin id and the MIME types it handles.
evals.expected_output: It provides a MediaThumbnail plugin id=media_thumbnail_svg (class MediaThumbnailSVG) whose mime list is image/svg and image/svg+xml; Media Thumbnails calls its createThumbnail() to build a PNG.

evals.prompt: media_thumbnails_svg converts SVG files to PNG thumbnails. Which rasterizers can it use, and in what priority order?
evals.expected_output: It tries GraphicsMagick (gm, best quality) first, then ImageMagick (convert), then falls back to PHP GD using the meyfa/php-svg library (lowest quality, always available).

evals.prompt: media_thumbnails_svg has no settings page of its own. Where do you set the thumbnail width and background color it uses, and in which config object are those values stored?
evals.expected_output: The SVG plugin reads its output settings from the parent Media Thumbnails module: config object media_thumbnails.settings (keys width, bgcolor_active, bgcolor_value), edited at /admin/config/media/thumbnails. Defaults are width 500, bgcolor_active false, bgcolor_value #eeeeee.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Media Thumbnails width used for SVG thumbnails has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state the current thumbnail width.
On this site a custom background color has been enabled for generated thumbnails. Inspect the live Media Thumbnails configuration and state the background color hex value in use.
evals.expected_output: bgcolor_active is true and bgcolor_value is #123456 in media_thumbnails.settings.

evals.prompt: Configure the Media Thumbnails settings that media_thumbnails_svg uses so that generated SVG thumbnails are 300 pixels wide. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set media_thumbnails.settings width = 300 (e.g. drush cset media_thumbnails.settings width 300).

evals.prompt: Enable a custom thumbnail background color of #ffffff for the thumbnails media_thumbnails_svg generates, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set media_thumbnails.settings bgcolor_active = true and bgcolor_value = #ffffff.
